# Vyzma AI — llms.txt
> Vyzma AI is India's premier AI agency founded by Teja Naik in 2024, headquartered in Visakhapatnam (Vizag) and Bangalore. We build AI chatbots, workflow automation, SEO/AEO/GEO, voice AI agents, custom AI development, website design, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and WhatsApp marketing for businesses across India's major cities.

Vyzma AI serves businesses across Visakhapatnam, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, and Ahmedabad. We combine machine learning engineering, marketing strategy, and business automation into integrated systems that produce measurable results. Phone: +91 91393 93097. Email: vyzmaai.in@gmail.com.

## Services

- https://vyzma.in/services/ai-chatbots: AI Chatbots — Conversational AI agents powered by GPT-4o and Claude for customer support, lead qualification, WhatsApp automation, and 24/7 query resolution.
- https://vyzma.in/services/workflow-automation: Workflow Automation — Automate repetitive tasks using n8n, Make.com, and custom API integrations connecting 500+ business applications.
- https://vyzma.in/services/seo-aeo-geo: SEO, AEO & GEO — AI Search Optimisation across Google (SEO), ChatGPT/Perplexity (AEO), and Google AI Overviews (GEO).
- https://vyzma.in/services/voice-ai: Voice AI Agents — Natural-sounding voice agents for calls, IVR replacement, and scheduling supporting Hindi, Telugu, English, Tamil, and 50+ languages.
- https://vyzma.in/services/custom-ai: Custom AI Development — Bespoke ML models, RAG systems, and fine-tuned language models with full IP ownership.
- https://vyzma.in/services/website-design: Website Design — High-performance Next.js websites with SSR, sub-2s load times, and built-in AI integrations.
- https://vyzma.in/services/google-ads: Google Ads Management — Data-driven search, display, shopping, and Performance Max campaigns optimised for ROAS.
- https://vyzma.in/services/meta-ads: Meta Ads — Facebook and Instagram advertising with creative development, targeting, and retargeting.
